en: A sepia-toned historic street scene showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks, tall street lamps, and several pedestrians. On the right stands a richly decorated multi-storey brick building with gables and dormers, bearing a hanging sign for a hotel and restaurant. Other brick houses line the street further down. The left side shows a wall with posters and trees behind it. Printed text in German identifies the hotel as 'Hotel–Restaurant Meidericher Hof' and the proprietor as 'L. Vaessen.' Another smaller sign on the building reads 'HOTEL Restaurant.' The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century European city.
